title: 从无查询摘要数据集中生成查询聚焦摘要数据集
summary: 本文提出一种基于证据的模型，从无查询数据集中自动生成查询关键词，用于查询聚焦摘要（QFS）任务。实验表明，基于证据生成的查询在ROUGE评分上与原始查询相当。
summary_en: This paper proposes an evidence-based model to automatically generate query keywords from query-free datasets for Query-Focused Summarization (QFS). Experiments show that summaries using evidence-based queries achieve competitive ROUGE scores compared to original queries.
